methodHandling.otherMethods: Not checked. Any method is served exactly like GET; body never read.

query.name: deckId
query.bounds: no format check; non-UUID -> ownsDeck Postgres error -> 500

query.name: v
query.parse: Number(p.get('v')); version = Number.isInteger(v) && v >= 1 ? v : 1; then readSlideImage treats version >= 2 as refined

checkOrder: 2. deckId present, slide positive integer (400 'Bad params')
4. readSlideImage(deckId, slide, version): new key then legacy variant_A key (404 'Image not found')
5. pdf-lib: create doc, embedPng, one page sized [png.width, png.height], image drawn full-bleed at 0,0

responses.bodyShape: single-page PDF (pdf-lib), page size in PDF points equal to the PNG pixel dimensions, PNG drawn full-bleed. <slide> in filename is the parsed Number, e.g. slide=01 -> slide_1.pdf. NO cache-control header (deliberate, so every download hits the function and is counted).

errors.when: deckId missing or slide not a positive integer
no PNG at new or legacy key for that version
non-UUID deckId (Postgres cast error), blob/DB failure, or pdf-lib embedPng throws because the stored bytes are not a PNG

sideEffects: void incrementExportCounts(userId, deckId) -> Supabase rpc 'increment_export_counts' (errors logged, not surfaced)
quirks: No cache-control header on purpose (pdf.ts:32-34 comment) - docs/api.md claims 'cache-control: private, max-age=3600', which is wrong.

Unlike /api/image, the PDF is built from the RAW stored PNG; tile slides are NOT composited with the brand master here (pdf.ts uses readSlideImage, not image.ts compositeIfTile). The frontend works around this by building tile PDFs client-side (src/lib/pdfDownload.ts:178-184).
v validation differs from /api/image: v>=1 accepted, else 1; both end up treating v>=2 as refined (pdf.ts:22; blobs.ts:41).
Counts as an export (increment_export_counts) on every successful call.
beforeAnyState: Deck owned but slide not yet rendered -> 404 'Image not found'. Deck row missing -> 403.

tests.asserts: No unit test covers pdf.ts (grep of netlify/functions/_tests for '../pdf' finds nothing).

callers.expects: res.ok -> blob; any non-2xx -> throws 'PDF download failed' and the caller silently falls back to client-side jsPDF assembly from /api/image. Not called for tile slides.

docs.apiMd: docs/api.md:1388-1414 - says cache-control: private, max-age=3600 is returned; code sends no cache-control (pdf.ts:36-42). Otherwise matches.

planSection65: Row '/api/pdf (GET ?deckId=&slide=&v=) ... application/pdf' - accurate. Add content-disposition 'attachment; filename="slide_<n>.pdf"', no cache-control, error strings, and that PDF content is the raw (non-composited) PNG.
